task: Integrate comprehensive Action Done Matrix (ADM) viewer into Capstone 2 card on Submissions page

user_intent.problem: Submissions page lacked an integrated Action Done Matrix (ADM) viewer inside the Capstone 2 card for viewing BukSU Form RU-F-033 defense remarks, actions taken, and committee endorsements.
user_intent.solution: Added dedicated in-card ADM Section Card with status badges, remarks metrics, in-place inline toggle, Capstone 2 card header button, top toolbar button, and full-screen modal viewer portaled to document.body defaulting to initialMilestone='CAPSTONE_2'.

frontend: client/src/components/projects/ActionDoneMatrixTab.jsx (added initialMilestone prop support defaulting to CAPSTONE_2 when invoked from Capstone 2 context)

client/src/pages/submissions/ProjectSubmissionsPage.jsx (added ActionDoneMatrixSection card, [Open Action Done Matrix] header button, [Action Done Matrix] top toolbar button, inline expansion toggle, and portaled modal dialog with createPortal(..., document.body))

client/src/pages/submissions/ProjectSubmissionsPage.test.jsx (updated test suite with mocked ActionDoneMatrixTab, modal opening/closing, inline expansion toggle, and portaled document.body dialog queries)

verification.unit_tests: ProjectSubmissionsPage.test.jsx (5/5 passed) & ActionDoneMatrixTab.test.jsx (6/6 passed) — 11/11 total passed
verification.visual_audit: Playwright visual audit completed across desktop dark/light, modal viewer, inline expansion, and mobile viewports with zero errors
